verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Shortwave itself offering IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access, or a standards-based export (e.g. mbox/EML). The founder says it integrates with Gmail's APIs rather than IMAP, and users report it works only with Gmail. The lock-in protection users describe, moving back by deleting the Shortwave account, comes from Gmail as the host platform and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
